title: got stuck in approval in pancake swap
description: got stuck in approval icon in pancake swap

asr.full_text: Hi Guys this is YokHD, now i am gonna show you how to solve the error of the approval button gets stuck and keeps loading in Pancake Swap. Like everyone i just bought a lot of meme coins. Now due to high network congestion in Binance chain the approval icon just got stuck. After they checked, all I had to do was check it and leave it as it is. I saw it and sent a link in the app. In my account, the approved account from the online community, and the app for your account name, were all same as in the first video. So it was no good. I checked the app again and went back to my account. just take another phone and install Trust Wallet app Then go to settings and wallets and select the drop down and click Show recovery phase on the other phone select I already have a wallet and hit Continue and select multi coin wallet now you can type in the phase usually 12 or twenty four words or select scan option and scan the QR code, and receive your currency card to get it back in. So after you get your currency card and your money you will receive cash account. I will just scan the QR code. And my wallet is back in my another phone. So now I can get the money and pass it to the other number. now click approval go to settings and increase the gas price aka gui to 13 and hit approve. within few seconds you must get approved. Before selecting swap, change the slippage tolerance to 5 or 12 depending on the meme coin you bought. Now swap and hit confirm Swap. Just Hit confirm and you are set to go. In few minute your transaction will get approved. Sometimes, The gas price of 13 is not enough and the same error occurs. Repeat the same process and set a higher gas fee. Finally, one important thing, don't forget to hit like and subscribe my channel.
